disclaimer: Educational self-assessment, not legal advice. Laws: ART (Regulation) Act 2021; DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025.

questions.question: Is the clinic registered on the National ART & Surrogacy Registry, with the registration number shown to patients and on the website?
questions.evidence: Registration certificate; website footer showing the number
questions.fix: Apply or renew on the National ART & Surrogacy Registry portal before offering ART services.

questions.question: Is the registration still within its 5-year validity, with the renewal date tracked?
questions.fix: Record the expiry date and start renewal well before it.

questions.question: Before treatment, do you verify with ID that the woman is 21–50 and the man is 21–55?
questions.evidence: Age-check step in intake form; ID copies on file
questions.fix: Add a mandatory age check with ID proof at registration.

questions.question: Do you take written informed consent from all parties before every ART procedure?
questions.fix: Use procedure-specific written consent forms signed by every party.

questions.question: Does the cryopreservation consent record what should happen to embryos or gametes on death or incapacity?
questions.fix: Add a death/incapacity instruction section to the cryopreservation consent.

questions.question: Is there a documented way for either partner to withdraw consent before embryo or gamete transfer?
questions.fix: Create a withdrawal form and check it before every transfer.

questions.question: Is professional counselling on implications and chances given and documented for every couple or woman?
questions.fix: Schedule and document counselling before treatment starts.

questions.question: Is it enforced that no more than three oocytes or embryos are placed in the uterus in a treatment cycle?
questions.fix: Add a hard stop in lab/EMR records above three.

questions.question: Are oocyte donors aged 23–35, donating only once in life, with no more than seven oocytes retrieved?
questions.evidence: Donor file; retrieval record; registry check
questions.fix: Check donor age and prior donation before accepting; cap retrieval at seven.

questions.question: Does every oocyte donor have insurance cover for 12 months before retrieval?
questions.fix: Buy 12-month donor insurance before any retrieval.

questions.question: Is pre-implantation genetic testing used only to screen for known, pre-existing, heritable or genetic diseases?
questions.fix: Record the medical indication for every PGT request; refuse others.

questions.question: Does the clinic never offer a child of a pre-determined sex, and never advertise sex-selective ART anywhere, including the website and social media?
questions.evidence: Website and social media review; staff instructions
questions.fix: Remove any such wording; brief all staff and agencies.

questions.question: Are detailed patient, donor and procedure records kept for at least 10 years?
questions.fix: Set a 10-year retention rule in EMR and paper archives.

questions.question: Do you share enrolment, procedure and outcome information with the National Registry as required?
questions.legal_basis: ART Act 2021 (duty to report to the National Registry)
questions.fix: Assign an owner and a monthly reporting routine.

questions.question: Is information about the couple, woman and donors kept confidential?
questions.fix: Write a confidentiality policy and restrict access to records.

questions.question: Does the clinic have a grievance cell that patients know how to reach?
questions.evidence: Grievance contact on website and reception
questions.fix: Set up a grievance cell and publish its contact.

questions.question: Are gamete donors and commissioning parties screened for eligibility before procedures?
questions.fix: Use a written eligibility checklist for every donor and couple.

questions.question: When collecting patient data, do you give a standalone notice listing the data collected, the purpose, and how to withdraw consent or complain to the Data Protection Board?
questions.evidence: Notice text on forms and website
questions.fix: Publish a plain-language notice and show it before consent.

questions.question: Is consent recorded per purpose, with date and time, and kept separate for marketing messages?
questions.fix: Log each consent with purpose, time and notice version.

questions.question: Can a patient withdraw consent as easily as they gave it, and does processing then stop?
questions.fix: Add a one-step withdrawal route and a procedure to act on it.

questions.question: Is the contact of a designated officer or Data Protection Officer shown clearly for data questions?
questions.legal_basis: DPDP Act 2023, Sec 8(9); DPDP Rules 2025 (contact information)
questions.fix: Name an officer and publish their contact.

questions.question: Are requests to access, correct or erase data logged and answered within 90 days?
questions.fix: Keep a request register and track the 90-day deadline.

questions.question: Is patient data encrypted or masked, in storage and in transit?
questions.fix: Turn on encryption at rest and TLS everywhere.

questions.question: Do staff see only the patient data their role needs (access control)?
questions.fix: Set role-based access and remove shared logins.

questions.question: Are access logs monitored and kept for at least one year?
questions.fix: Enable access logs and keep them 12 months or more.

questions.question: Are backups taken and restore-tested?
questions.fix: Schedule backups and test a restore each quarter.

questions.question: Is there a breach plan to inform affected patients without delay and report to the Data Protection Board within 72 hours?
questions.legal_basis: DPDP Act 2023, Sec 8(6); DPDP Rules 2025 (breach intimation, 72 hours to the Board)
questions.fix: Write a breach plan with owners, templates and the 72-hour clock.

questions.question: Do vendors that handle patient data (EMR, LIMS, cloud, AI tools) work under written contracts with security terms?
questions.legal_basis: DPDP Act 2023, Sec 8(2) (processors only under a valid contract)
questions.fix: Sign data-processing terms with every vendor.

questions.question: Is data deleted once its purpose is served, except where law requires keeping it (e.g., ART records for 10 years)?
questions.legal_basis: DPDP Act 2023, Sec 8(7) (erase when purpose ends, unless law requires retention); ART Act Sec 21
questions.fix: Write a retention schedule that reconciles DPDP and ART rules.

questions.question: Where you process data of anyone under 18, do you get verifiable parental consent unless a healthcare exemption applies?
questions.fix: Add a parental consent step or record the exemption relied on.

questions.question: Are staff trained on handling patient data, including not sharing reports on personal WhatsApp groups?
questions.legal_basis: Good practice supporting DPDP security duties
questions.fix: Run a short yearly training and keep attendance.
